配置

全局配置 AsamConfigProvider

向子树提供组件配置和 ASAM 控件密度。

使用场景 ​

向子树提供组件配置和 ASAM 控件密度。

基础用法与状态 ​

下列示例只使用本入口的实际公开能力。

基础用法与状态

展开源码
场景源码 ZIP完整工程 ZIP
vue
<template>
	<label class="provider-setting">
		<span>继承密度</span>
		<AsamSelect v-model="size">
			<AsamOption v-for="value in sizes" :key="value" :label="value" :value="value">
				{{ value }}
			</AsamOption>
		</AsamSelect>
	</label>
	<AsamConfigProvider :size="size">
		<div class="actions">
			<AsamTag>继承 {{ size }}</AsamTag>
			<AsamTag size="small">显式 small 优先</AsamTag>
		</div>
	</AsamConfigProvider>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamConfigProviderBasicDemo' });
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamSelect, AsamOption, AsamConfigProvider, AsamTag } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamControlSize } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const sizes: AsamControlSize[] = ['large', 'big', 'default', 'small'];
const size = ref<AsamControlSize>('default');
</script>

<style scoped>
.provider-setting {
	margin-block-end: var(--asam-space-lg);
}

.provider-setting,
.actions {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	gap: var(--asam-space-md);
	align-items: center;
}
</style>

按钮与链接默认颜色 ​

按钮与链接默认颜色

展开源码
场景源码 ZIP完整工程 ZIP
vue
<template>
	<section class="colors" aria-label="按钮默认颜色">
		<AsamConfigProvider
			v-for="entry in buttonTypes"
			:key="entry.value"
			:button="{ type: entry.value }"
		>
			<AsamButton @click="selected = entry.label"
				>{{ entry.label }}（{{ entry.value || '空值' }}）</AsamButton
			>
		</AsamConfigProvider>
	</section>
	<section class="colors" aria-label="链接默认颜色">
		<AsamConfigProvider
			v-for="entry in linkTypes"
			:key="entry.value"
			:link="{ type: entry.value }"
		>
			<AsamLink href="#demo-semantic-colors">{{ entry.label }}（{{ entry.value }}）</AsamLink>
		</AsamConfigProvider>
	</section>
	<p role="status">当前按钮：{{ selected }}</p>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { shallowRef } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamConfigProvider, AsamLink } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type {
	AsamConfigProviderButtonConfigContext,
	AsamConfigProviderLinkConfigContext
} from '@asam-ui/ui';

const buttonTypes = [
	{ value: 'default', label: '默认' },
	{ value: 'primary', label: '主要' },
	{ value: 'success', label: '成功' },
	{ value: 'warning', label: '警告' },
	{ value: 'danger', label: '危险' },
	{ value: 'info', label: '信息' },
	{ value: '', label: '空字符串' }
] satisfies { value: NonNullable<AsamConfigProviderButtonConfigContext['type']>; label: string }[];
const linkTypes = [
	{ value: 'default', label: '默认' },
	{ value: 'primary', label: '主要' },
	{ value: 'success', label: '成功' },
	{ value: 'warning', label: '警告' },
	{ value: 'danger', label: '危险' },
	{ value: 'info', label: '信息' }
] satisfies { value: NonNullable<AsamConfigProviderLinkConfigContext['type']>; label: string }[];
const selected = shallowRef('尚未选择');
</script>

<style scoped>
.colors {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	gap: var(--asam-space-md);
	align-items: center;
}
.colors + .colors {
	margin-block-start: var(--asam-space-md);
}
</style>

使用约定 ​

size 接受 large/big/default/small，省略时保留默认密度；配置变化保持响应式。 完整说明。

完整使用场景 ​

i18n 配置 ​

通过 Config Provider 来配置多语言，让你的应用可以随时切换语言。

使用两个属性来提供 i18n 相关配置

i18n 配置

展开源码
许可场景源码 ZIP完整工程 ZIP
vue
<template>
	<div class="demo-layout-1">
		<AsamButton type="primary" class="ui032-mb-2" @click="toggle">切换语言</AsamButton>
		<br />

		<AsamConfigProvider :locale="locale">
			<div class="demo-provider-layout-1">
				<AsamTable :data="[]" class="ui032-mb-1" />
				<AsamPagination :total="100" />
			</div>
		</AsamConfigProvider>
	</div>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamConfigProviderCapUsageDemo' });
import { AsamButton, AsamConfigProvider, AsamTable, AsamPagination } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { computed, ref } from 'vue';
import { asamLocaleZhCn as zhCn } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { asamLocaleEn as en } from '@asam-ui/ui';

const language = ref('zh-cn');
const locale = computed(() => (language.value === 'zh-cn' ? zhCn : en));

const toggle = () => {
	language.value = language.value === 'zh-cn' ? 'en' : 'zh-cn';
};
</script>

<style scoped>
.ui032-mb-2 {
	margin-bottom: var(--asam-space-sm);
}

.ui032-mb-1 {
	margin-bottom: var(--asam-space-xs);
}
</style>

<style scoped>
.demo-layout-1 {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	align-items: center;
	gap: var(--asam-space-md);
}
</style>

<style scoped>
.demo-provider-layout-1 {
	display: grid;
	gap: var(--asam-space-md);
	justify-items: start;
}
.demo-provider-layout-1 > :is(p, pre, output) {
	margin-block: 0;
}
</style>

对 Dialog 进行配置 2.10.7

展开源码
许可场景源码 ZIP完整工程 ZIP
vue
<template>
	<div class="flex flex-col gap-4 justify-center">
		<div class="flex items-center gap-2">
			<AsamSwitch
				:model-value="config.alignCenter"
				active-text="alignCenter"
				@update:model-value="
					(value) => {
						if (typeof value === 'boolean') config.alignCenter = value;
					}
				"
			/>
		</div>
		<div class="flex items-center gap-4">
			<AsamSwitch
				:model-value="config.draggable"
				active-text="draggable"
				@update:model-value="
					(value) => {
						if (typeof value === 'boolean') config.draggable = value;
					}
				"
			/>
			<AsamSwitch
				:model-value="config.overflow"
				:disabled="!config.draggable"
				active-text="overflow"
				@update:model-value="
					(value) => {
						if (typeof value === 'boolean') config.overflow = value;
					}
				"
			/>
		</div>
		<div class="flex items-center gap-2">
			<AsamSwitch
				:model-value="enableTransition"
				active-text="启用过渡效果"
				@update:model-value="
					(value) => {
						if (typeof value === 'boolean') enableTransition = value;
					}
				"
			/>
			<AsamSwitch
				:model-value="isObjectTransition"
				:disabled="!enableTransition"
				active-text="transition: object"
				inactive-text="transition: string"
				@update:model-value="
					(value) => {
						if (typeof value === 'boolean') isObjectTransition = value;
					}
				"
			/>
		</div>
		<div class="flex items-center gap-2">
			<!-- prettier-ignore -->
			<AsamButton
				ref="buttonRef"
			 type="primary"
				size="small"
				@click="visible = true"
			>
				打开对话框
			</AsamButton>
		</div>
		<AsamConfigProvider :dialog="globalConfig">
			<AsamDialog v-model="visible" title="对话框标题" destroy-on-close>
				对话框内容
			</AsamDialog>
		</AsamConfigProvider>
		<div v-if="enableTransition" class="text-xs opacity-70">
			<div v-if="isObjectTransition">
				使用 JavaScript 控制动画：
				<code>{{ JSON.stringify(globalConfig.transition) }}</code>
			</div>
			<div v-else>
				使用字符串过渡名称：
				<code>{{ globalConfig.transition }}</code>
			</div>
		</div>
	</div>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamConfigProviderCapDialogDemo' });
import { AsamSwitch, AsamButton, AsamConfigProvider, AsamDialog } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { computed, nextTick, ref, shallowReactive } from 'vue';

import type { AsamButtonExpose, AsamConfigProviderProps } from '@asam-ui/ui';

type GlobalConfig = {
	alignCenter: boolean;
	draggable: boolean;
	overflow: boolean;
	transition?: NonNullable<AsamConfigProviderProps['dialog']>['transition'];
};

const config = shallowReactive<GlobalConfig>({
	alignCenter: false,
	draggable: false,
	overflow: false
});
const visible = ref(false);
const enableTransition = ref(false);
const isObjectTransition = ref(false);

const buttonRef = ref<AsamButtonExpose>();

const ANIMATION_DURATION = 300;

const globalConfig = computed<GlobalConfig>(() => {
	let transition: NonNullable<AsamConfigProviderProps['dialog']>['transition'] | undefined;
	if (enableTransition.value) {
		if (isObjectTransition.value) {
			transition = {
				css: false,
				onBeforeEnter(el) {
					nextTick(() => {
						if (buttonRef.value) {
							const buttonRect = buttonRef.value.ref!.getBoundingClientRect();
							const dialogEl = el.querySelector('.el-dialog') as HTMLElement;

							if (dialogEl) {
								const dialogRect = dialogEl.getBoundingClientRect();

								const offsetX =
									buttonRect.left +
									buttonRect.width / 2 -
									(dialogRect.left + dialogRect.width / 2);
								const offsetY =
									buttonRect.top +
									buttonRect.height / 2 -
									(dialogRect.top + dialogRect.height / 2);

								dialogEl.style.transform = `translate(${offsetX}px, ${offsetY}px) scale(0.3)`;
								dialogEl.style.opacity = '0';
							}
						}
					});
				},
				onEnter(el, done) {
					nextTick(() => {
						const dialogEl = el.querySelector('.el-dialog') as HTMLElement;
						if (dialogEl) {
							// force reflow
							void dialogEl.offsetHeight;

							dialogEl.style.transition = `all ${ANIMATION_DURATION}ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 1, 1)`;
							dialogEl.style.transform = 'translate(0, 0) scale(1)';
							dialogEl.style.opacity = '1';

							// wait for animation to complete, then cleanup inline styles to avoid affecting drag
							setTimeout(() => {
								dialogEl.style.transition = '';
								dialogEl.style.transform = '';
								dialogEl.style.opacity = '';
								done();
							}, ANIMATION_DURATION);
						} else {
							done();
						}
					});
				},
				onLeave(el, done) {
					const dialogEl = el.querySelector('.el-dialog') as HTMLElement;
					if (dialogEl) {
						if (buttonRef.value) {
							const buttonRect = buttonRef.value.ref!.getBoundingClientRect();
							const dialogRect = dialogEl.getBoundingClientRect();

							const currentTransform = dialogEl.style.transform;
							let dragOffsetX = 0;
							let dragOffsetY = 0;

							// avoid draggable effect
							if (currentTransform) {
								const translateMatch = currentTransform.match(
									/translate\(([^,]+),\s*([^)]+)\)/
								);
								if (translateMatch) {
									dragOffsetX = Number.parseFloat(translateMatch[1]);
									dragOffsetY = Number.parseFloat(translateMatch[2]);
								}
							}

							const offsetX =
								buttonRect.left +
								buttonRect.width / 2 -
								(dialogRect.left + dialogRect.width / 2) +
								dragOffsetX;
							const offsetY =
								buttonRect.top +
								buttonRect.height / 2 -
								(dialogRect.top + dialogRect.height / 2) +
								dragOffsetY;

							dialogEl.style.transition = `all ${ANIMATION_DURATION}ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 1, 1)`;
							dialogEl.style.transform = `translate(${offsetX}px, ${offsetY}px) scale(0.3)`;
							dialogEl.style.opacity = '0';

							// wait for animation to complete, then cleanup inline styles
							setTimeout(() => {
								dialogEl.style.transition = '';
								dialogEl.style.transform = '';
								dialogEl.style.opacity = '';
								done();
							}, ANIMATION_DURATION);
						} else {
							done();
						}
					} else {
						done();
					}
				}
			};
		} else {
			transition = 'dialog-bounce';
		}
	}
	return {
		alignCenter: config.alignCenter,
		draggable: config.draggable,
		overflow: config.overflow,
		transition
	};
});
</script>

<style>
/* Bounce Animation */
.dialog-bounce-enter-active,
.dialog-bounce-leave-active,
.dialog-bounce-enter-active .el-dialog,
.dialog-bounce-leave-active .el-dialog {
	transition: all 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.175, 0.885, 0.32, 1.275);
}

.dialog-bounce-enter-from,
.dialog-bounce-leave-to {
	opacity: 0;
}

.dialog-bounce-enter-from .el-dialog,
.dialog-bounce-leave-to .el-dialog {
	transform: scale(0.3) translateY(-50px);
	opacity: 0;
}
</style>

		<div class="flex items-center gap-2">
			<AsamSwitch
				:model-value="config.alignCenter"
				active-text="alignCenter"
				@update:model-value="
					(value) => {
						if (typeof value === 'boolean') config.alignCenter = value;
					}
				"
			/>
		</div>
		<div class="flex items-center gap-4">
			<AsamSwitch
				:model-value="config.draggable"
				active-text="draggable"
				@update:model-value="
					(value) => {
						if (typeof value === 'boolean') config.draggable = value;
					}
				"
			/>
			<AsamSwitch
				:model-value="config.overflow"
				:disabled="!config.draggable"
				active-text="overflow"
				@update:model-value="
					(value) => {
						if (typeof value === 'boolean') config.overflow = value;
					}
				"
			/>
		</div>
		<div class="flex items-center gap-2">
			<AsamSwitch
				:model-value="enableTransition"
				active-text="启用过渡效果"
				@update:model-value="
					(value) => {
						if (typeof value === 'boolean') enableTransition = value;
					}
				"
			/>
			<AsamSwitch
				:model-value="isObjectTransition"
				:disabled="!enableTransition"
				active-text="transition: object"
				inactive-text="transition: string"
				@update:model-value="
					(value) => {
						if (typeof value === 'boolean') isObjectTransition = value;
					}
				"
			/>
		</div>
		<div class="flex items-center gap-2">
			<!-- prettier-ignore -->
			<AsamButton
				ref="buttonRef"
			 type="primary"
				size="small"
				@click="visible = true"
			>
				打开对话框
			</AsamButton>
		</div>
		<AsamConfigProvider :dialog="globalConfig">
			<AsamDialog v-model="visible" title="对话框标题" destroy-on-close>
				对话框内容
			</AsamDialog>
		</AsamConfigProvider>
		<div v-if="enableTransition" class="text-xs opacity-70">
			<div v-if="isObjectTransition">
				使用 JavaScript 控制动画：
				<code>{{ JSON.stringify(globalConfig.transition) }}</code>
			</div>
			<div v-else>
				使用字符串过渡名称：
				<code>{{ globalConfig.transition }}</code>
			</div>
		</div>
	</div>
</template>

<script setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamConfigProviderCapDialogDemo' });
import { AsamSwitch, AsamButton, AsamConfigProvider, AsamDialog } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { computed, nextTick, ref, shallowReactive } from 'vue';
const config = shallowReactive({
	alignCenter: false,
	draggable: false,
	overflow: false
});
const visible = ref(false);
const enableTransition = ref(false);
const isObjectTransition = ref(false);
const buttonRef = ref();
const ANIMATION_DURATION = 300;
const globalConfig = computed(() => {
	let transition;
	if (enableTransition.value) {
		if (isObjectTransition.value) {
			transition = {
				css: false,
				onBeforeEnter(el) {
					nextTick(() => {
						if (buttonRef.value) {
							const buttonRect = buttonRef.value.ref.getBoundingClientRect();
							const dialogEl = el.querySelector('.el-dialog');
							if (dialogEl) {
								const dialogRect = dialogEl.getBoundingClientRect();
								const offsetX =
									buttonRect.left +
									buttonRect.width / 2 -
									(dialogRect.left + dialogRect.width / 2);
								const offsetY =
									buttonRect.top +
									buttonRect.height / 2 -
									(dialogRect.top + dialogRect.height / 2);
								dialogEl.style.transform = `translate(${offsetX}px, ${offsetY}px) scale(0.3)`;
								dialogEl.style.opacity = '0';
							}
						}
					});
				},
				onEnter(el, done) {
					nextTick(() => {
						const dialogEl = el.querySelector('.el-dialog');
						if (dialogEl) {
							// force reflow
							void dialogEl.offsetHeight;
							dialogEl.style.transition = `all ${ANIMATION_DURATION}ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 1, 1)`;
							dialogEl.style.transform = 'translate(0, 0) scale(1)';
							dialogEl.style.opacity = '1';
							// wait for animation to complete, then cleanup inline styles to avoid affecting drag
							setTimeout(() => {
								dialogEl.style.transition = '';
								dialogEl.style.transform = '';
								dialogEl.style.opacity = '';
								done();
							}, ANIMATION_DURATION);
						} else {
							done();
						}
					});
				},
				onLeave(el, done) {
					const dialogEl = el.querySelector('.el-dialog');
					if (dialogEl) {
						if (buttonRef.value) {
							const buttonRect = buttonRef.value.ref.getBoundingClientRect();
							const dialogRect = dialogEl.getBoundingClientRect();
							const currentTransform = dialogEl.style.transform;
							let dragOffsetX = 0;
							let dragOffsetY = 0;
							// avoid draggable effect
							if (currentTransform) {
								const translateMatch = currentTransform.match(
									/translate\(([^,]+),\s*([^)]+)\)/
								);
								if (translateMatch) {
									dragOffsetX = Number.parseFloat(translateMatch[1]);
									dragOffsetY = Number.parseFloat(translateMatch[2]);
								}
							}
							const offsetX =
								buttonRect.left +
								buttonRect.width / 2 -
								(dialogRect.left + dialogRect.width / 2) +
								dragOffsetX;
							const offsetY =
								buttonRect.top +
								buttonRect.height / 2 -
								(dialogRect.top + dialogRect.height / 2) +
								dragOffsetY;
							dialogEl.style.transition = `all ${ANIMATION_DURATION}ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 1, 1)`;
							dialogEl.style.transform = `translate(${offsetX}px, ${offsetY}px) scale(0.3)`;
							dialogEl.style.opacity = '0';
							// wait for animation to complete, then cleanup inline styles
							setTimeout(() => {
								dialogEl.style.transition = '';
								dialogEl.style.transform = '';
								dialogEl.style.opacity = '';
								done();
							}, ANIMATION_DURATION);
						} else {
							done();
						}
					} else {
						done();
					}
				}
			};
		} else {
			transition = 'dialog-bounce';
		}
	}
	return {
		alignCenter: config.alignCenter,
		draggable: config.draggable,
		overflow: config.overflow,
		transition
	};
});
</script>

/* Bounce Animation */
.dialog-bounce-enter-active,
.dialog-bounce-leave-active,
.dialog-bounce-enter-active .el-dialog,
.dialog-bounce-leave-active .el-dialog {
	transition: all 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.175, 0.885, 0.32, 1.275);
}

.dialog-bounce-enter-from,
.dialog-bounce-leave-to {
	opacity: 0;
}

.dialog-bounce-enter-from .el-dialog,
.dialog-bounce-leave-to .el-dialog {

	opacity: 0;
}
</style>

空值配置2.7.0 ​

支持的组件列表
  • 级联选择器（AsamCascader）
  • 颜色选择器（AsamColorPicker） ^(2.10.3)
  • 日期选择器（AsamDatePicker）
  • 选择器（AsamSelect）
  • 虚拟化选择器（AsamSelectV2）
  • 时间选择器（AsamTimePicker）
  • 时间选择（AsamTimeSelect）
  • 树形选择器（AsamTreeSelect）

设置 empty-values 来配置组件的默认空值。默认值是 ['', null, undefined]。如果认为空字符串不是一个空值，可以设置成 [undefined, null]。

设置 value-on-clear 以设置清空选项的值。组件默认值是 undefined。在日期组件中是 null。如果想设置成 undefined，请使用 () => undefined。

native 模式保留原生清空值；默认 value 模式将单选 undefined 归一为 null。 完整说明。

空值配置2.7.0

展开源码
许可场景源码 ZIP完整工程 ZIP

				:model-value="value1"
				clearable
				placeholder="选择"
				style="width: 240px"
				@update:model-value="

						if (typeof value === 'string' || value === null) value1 = value;

零层级与响应式密度 ​

zIndex=0 是有效输入，省略配置仍继承上层值。密度按已冻结四档契约继承，显式 size 覆盖 provider。ConfigProvider default 插槽中的 config 是实际配置上下文，可响应更新。

零层级与响应式密度

展开源码
场景源码 ZIP完整工程 ZIP
vue
<template>
	<div class="demo-root-layout">
		<AsamButton
			type="primary"
			native-type="button"
			@click="size = size === 'big' ? 'small' : 'big'"
		>
			切换密度

): Pick<HTMLAttributes, 'class'> & DemoDataAttributes => ({

<template>
	<section class="component-project" data-demo-host>
		<label
			>演示场景<AsamSelect
				:model-value="selected"
				aria-label="演示场景"

					v-for="option in options"

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { computed, defineAsyncComponent, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import { AsamSelect, AsamOption } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const options = [
	{ value: 'basic/ts', label: '基础用法与状态 (TS)' },
	{ value: 'basic/js', label: '基础用法与状态 (JS)' },
	{ value: 'semantic-colors/ts', label: '按钮与链接默认颜色 (TS)' },
	{ value: 'semantic-colors/js', label: '按钮与链接默认颜色 (JS)' },
	{ value: 'cap-usage/ts', label: 'i18n 配置 (TS)' },
	{ value: 'cap-usage/js', label: 'i18n 配置 (JS)' },
	{ value: 'cap-button/ts', label: '对按钮进行配置 (TS)' },
	{ value: 'cap-button/js', label: '对按钮进行配置 (JS)' },
	{ value: 'cap-link/ts', label: '对链接进行配置2.9.11 (TS)' },
	{ value: 'cap-link/js', label: '对链接进行配置2.9.11 (JS)' },
	{ value: 'cap-card/ts', label: '对 Card 进行配置 2.10.5 (TS)' },
	{ value: 'cap-card/js', label: '对 Card 进行配置 2.10.5 (JS)' },
	{ value: 'cap-dialog/ts', label: '对 Dialog 进行配置 2.10.7 (TS)' },
	{ value: 'cap-dialog/js', label: '对 Dialog 进行配置 2.10.7 (JS)' },
	{ value: 'cap-message/ts', label: '对消息进行配置 (TS)' },
	{ value: 'cap-message/js', label: '对消息进行配置 (JS)' },
	{ value: 'cap-empty-values/ts', label: '空值配置2.7.0 (TS)' },
	{ value: 'cap-empty-values/js', label: '空值配置2.7.0 (JS)' },
	{ value: 'cap-table/ts', label: '表格配置 2.13.3 (TS)' },
	{ value: 'cap-table/js', label: '表格配置 2.13.3 (JS)' },
	{ value: 'boundaries/ts', label: '零层级与响应式密度 (TS)' },
	{ value: 'boundaries/js', label: '零层级与响应式密度 (JS)' }
] as const;
const scenarios = {
	'basic/ts': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/basic/ts/Demo.vue')),
	'basic/js': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/basic/js/Demo.vue')),
	'semantic-colors/ts': defineAsyncComponent(
		() => import('./examples/semantic-colors/ts/Demo.vue')
	),
	'semantic-colors/js': defineAsyncComponent(
		() => import('./examples/semantic-colors/js/Demo.vue')
	),
	'cap-usage/ts': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/cap-usage/ts/Demo.vue')),
	'cap-usage/js': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/cap-usage/js/Demo.vue')),
	'cap-button/ts': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/cap-button/ts/Demo.vue')),
	'cap-button/js': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/cap-button/js/Demo.vue')),
	'cap-link/ts': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/cap-link/ts/Demo.vue')),
	'cap-link/js': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/cap-link/js/Demo.vue')),
	'cap-card/ts': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/cap-card/ts/Demo.vue')),
	'cap-card/js': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/cap-card/js/Demo.vue')),
	'cap-dialog/ts': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/cap-dialog/ts/Demo.vue')),
	'cap-dialog/js': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/cap-dialog/js/Demo.vue')),
	'cap-message/ts': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/cap-message/ts/Demo.vue')),
	'cap-message/js': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/cap-message/js/Demo.vue')),
	'cap-empty-values/ts': defineAsyncComponent(
		() => import('./examples/cap-empty-values/ts/Demo.vue')
	),
	'cap-empty-values/js': defineAsyncComponent(
		() => import('./examples/cap-empty-values/js/Demo.vue')
	),
	'cap-table/ts': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/cap-table/ts/Demo.vue')),
	'cap-table/js': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/cap-table/js/Demo.vue')),
	'boundaries/ts': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/boundaries/ts/Demo.vue')),
	'boundaries/js': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/boundaries/js/Demo.vue'))
};
const selected = shallowRef<keyof typeof scenarios>('basic/ts');
function selectScenario(value: unknown) {
	const option = options.find((option) => option.value === value);
	if (option) selected.value = option.value;
}
const current = computed(() => scenarios[selected.value]);
</script>

const language = ref('zh-cn');

<template>
	<div class="flex flex-col gap-4 justify-center">
		<div class="flex items-center gap-2">
			<AsamSwitch
				:model-value="config.alignCenter"
				active-text="alignCenter"
				@update:model-value="
					(value) => {
						if (typeof value === 'boolean') config.alignCenter = value;
					}
				"
			/>
		</div>
		<div class="flex items-center gap-4">
			<AsamSwitch
				:model-value="config.draggable"
				active-text="draggable"
				@update:model-value="
					(value) => {
						if (typeof value === 'boolean') config.draggable = value;
					}
				"
			/>
			<AsamSwitch
				:model-value="config.overflow"
				:disabled="!config.draggable"
				active-text="overflow"
				@update:model-value="
					(value) => {
						if (typeof value === 'boolean') config.overflow = value;
					}
				"
			/>
		</div>
		<div class="flex items-center gap-2">
			<AsamSwitch
				:model-value="enableTransition"
				active-text="启用过渡效果"
				@update:model-value="
					(value) => {
						if (typeof value === 'boolean') enableTransition = value;
					}
				"
			/>
			<AsamSwitch
				:model-value="isObjectTransition"
				:disabled="!enableTransition"
				active-text="transition: object"
				inactive-text="transition: string"
				@update:model-value="
					(value) => {
						if (typeof value === 'boolean') isObjectTransition = value;
					}
				"
			/>
		</div>
		<div class="flex items-center gap-2">
			<!-- prettier-ignore -->
			<AsamButton
				ref="buttonRef"
			 type="primary"
				size="small"
				@click="visible = true"
			>
				打开对话框
			</AsamButton>
		</div>
		<AsamConfigProvider :dialog="globalConfig">
			<AsamDialog v-model="visible" title="对话框标题" destroy-on-close>
				对话框内容
			</AsamDialog>
		</AsamConfigProvider>
		<div v-if="enableTransition" class="text-xs opacity-70">
			<div v-if="isObjectTransition">
				使用 JavaScript 控制动画：
				<code>{{ JSON.stringify(globalConfig.transition) }}</code>
			</div>
			<div v-else>
				使用字符串过渡名称：
				<code>{{ globalConfig.transition }}</code>
			</div>
		</div>
	</div>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamConfigProviderCapDialogDemo' });
import { AsamSwitch, AsamButton, AsamConfigProvider, AsamDialog } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { computed, nextTick, ref, shallowReactive } from 'vue';

import type { AsamButtonExpose, AsamConfigProviderProps } from '@asam-ui/ui';

type GlobalConfig = {
	alignCenter: boolean;
	draggable: boolean;
	overflow: boolean;
	transition?: NonNullable<AsamConfigProviderProps['dialog']>['transition'];
};

const config = shallowReactive<GlobalConfig>({
	alignCenter: false,
	draggable: false,
	overflow: false
});
const visible = ref(false);
const enableTransition = ref(false);
const isObjectTransition = ref(false);

const buttonRef = ref<AsamButtonExpose>();

const ANIMATION_DURATION = 300;

const globalConfig = computed<GlobalConfig>(() => {
	let transition: NonNullable<AsamConfigProviderProps['dialog']>['transition'] | undefined;
	if (enableTransition.value) {
		if (isObjectTransition.value) {
			transition = {
				css: false,
				onBeforeEnter(el) {
					nextTick(() => {
						if (buttonRef.value) {
							const buttonRect = buttonRef.value.ref!.getBoundingClientRect();
							const dialogEl = el.querySelector('.el-dialog') as HTMLElement;

							if (dialogEl) {
								const dialogRect = dialogEl.getBoundingClientRect();

								const offsetX =
									buttonRect.left +
									buttonRect.width / 2 -
									(dialogRect.left + dialogRect.width / 2);
								const offsetY =
									buttonRect.top +
									buttonRect.height / 2 -
									(dialogRect.top + dialogRect.height / 2);

								dialogEl.style.transform = `translate(${offsetX}px, ${offsetY}px) scale(0.3)`;
								dialogEl.style.opacity = '0';
							}
						}
					});
				},
				onEnter(el, done) {
					nextTick(() => {
						const dialogEl = el.querySelector('.el-dialog') as HTMLElement;
						if (dialogEl) {
							// force reflow
							void dialogEl.offsetHeight;

							dialogEl.style.transition = `all ${ANIMATION_DURATION}ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 1, 1)`;
							dialogEl.style.transform = 'translate(0, 0) scale(1)';
							dialogEl.style.opacity = '1';

							// wait for animation to complete, then cleanup inline styles to avoid affecting drag
							setTimeout(() => {
								dialogEl.style.transition = '';
								dialogEl.style.transform = '';
								dialogEl.style.opacity = '';
								done();
							}, ANIMATION_DURATION);
						} else {
							done();
						}
					});
				},
				onLeave(el, done) {
					const dialogEl = el.querySelector('.el-dialog') as HTMLElement;
					if (dialogEl) {
						if (buttonRef.value) {
							const buttonRect = buttonRef.value.ref!.getBoundingClientRect();
							const dialogRect = dialogEl.getBoundingClientRect();

							const currentTransform = dialogEl.style.transform;
							let dragOffsetX = 0;
							let dragOffsetY = 0;

							// avoid draggable effect
							if (currentTransform) {
								const translateMatch = currentTransform.match(
									/translate\(([^,]+),\s*([^)]+)\)/
								);
								if (translateMatch) {
									dragOffsetX = Number.parseFloat(translateMatch[1]);
									dragOffsetY = Number.parseFloat(translateMatch[2]);
								}
							}

							const offsetX =
								buttonRect.left +
								buttonRect.width / 2 -
								(dialogRect.left + dialogRect.width / 2) +
								dragOffsetX;
							const offsetY =
								buttonRect.top +
								buttonRect.height / 2 -
								(dialogRect.top + dialogRect.height / 2) +
								dragOffsetY;

							dialogEl.style.transition = `all ${ANIMATION_DURATION}ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 1, 1)`;
							dialogEl.style.transform = `translate(${offsetX}px, ${offsetY}px) scale(0.3)`;
							dialogEl.style.opacity = '0';

							// wait for animation to complete, then cleanup inline styles
							setTimeout(() => {
								dialogEl.style.transition = '';
								dialogEl.style.transform = '';
								dialogEl.style.opacity = '';
								done();
							}, ANIMATION_DURATION);
						} else {
							done();
						}
					} else {
						done();
					}
				}
			};
		} else {
			transition = 'dialog-bounce';
		}
	}
	return {
		alignCenter: config.alignCenter,
		draggable: config.draggable,
		overflow: config.overflow,
		transition
	};
});
</script>

<style>
/* Bounce Animation */
.dialog-bounce-enter-active,
.dialog-bounce-leave-active,
.dialog-bounce-enter-active .el-dialog,
.dialog-bounce-leave-active .el-dialog {
	transition: all 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.175, 0.885, 0.32, 1.275);
}

.dialog-bounce-enter-from,
.dialog-bounce-leave-to {
	opacity: 0;
}

.dialog-bounce-enter-from .el-dialog,
.dialog-bounce-leave-to .el-dialog {
	transform: scale(0.3) translateY(-50px);
	opacity: 0;
}
</style>

}

.opacity-70 {
	opacity: 0.7;
}
</style>

							const dialogRect = dialogEl.getBoundingClientRect();
							const currentTransform = dialogEl.style.transform;
							let dragOffsetX = 0;
							let dragOffsetY = 0;
							// avoid draggable effect
							if (currentTransform) {
								const translateMatch = currentTransform.match(
									/translate\(([^,]+),\s*([^)]+)\)/
								);
								if (translateMatch) {
									dragOffsetX = Number.parseFloat(translateMatch[1]);
									dragOffsetY = Number.parseFloat(translateMatch[2]);
								}
							}
							const offsetX =
								buttonRect.left +
								buttonRect.width / 2 -
								(dialogRect.left + dialogRect.width / 2) +
								dragOffsetX;
							const offsetY =
								buttonRect.top +
								buttonRect.height / 2 -
								(dialogRect.top + dialogRect.height / 2) +
								dragOffsetY;
							dialogEl.style.transition = `all ${ANIMATION_DURATION}ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 1, 1)`;
							dialogEl.style.transform = `translate(${offsetX}px, ${offsetY}px) scale(0.3)`;
							dialogEl.style.opacity = '0';
							// wait for animation to complete, then cleanup inline styles
							setTimeout(() => {
								dialogEl.style.transition = '';
								dialogEl.style.transform = '';
								dialogEl.style.opacity = '';
								done();
							}, ANIMATION_DURATION);
						} else {
							done();
						}
					} else {
						done();
					}
				}
			};
		} else {
			transition = 'dialog-bounce';
		}
	}
	return {
		alignCenter: config.alignCenter,
		draggable: config.draggable,
		overflow: config.overflow,
		transition
	};
});
</script>

<style>

.dialog-bounce-leave-active,
.dialog-bounce-enter-active .el-dialog,
.dialog-bounce-leave-active .el-dialog {
	transition: all 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.175, 0.885, 0.32, 1.275);
}

.dialog-bounce-enter-from,
.dialog-bounce-leave-to {
	opacity: 0;
}

.dialog-bounce-enter-from .el-dialog,
.dialog-bounce-leave-to .el-dialog {
	transform: scale(0.3) translateY(-50px);
	opacity: 0;
}
</style>

# AsamConfigProvider 全部场景

Node22.19+的22.x、pnpm11.9.0。在本目录执行pnpm install --frozen-lockfile、pnpm run typecheck、pnpm run dev、pnpm run build。vendor为固定正常包，保留锁文件和patches，不引用网站源码或借用node_modules。

界面中的场景选择器列出本组件全部真实TS/JS用法。src/examples/<场景>/<语言>/保留各场景原文件名、相对导入和资产；文件没有拼接进Demo.vue。主入口与所有场景配置也在文档的完整工程文件面板中。选择另一个场景会卸载前一个实例；文档中只切源文件则不会重挂载。

演示许可与第三方说明位于LICENSE、THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md及来源文件同目录的LICENSE-<摘要>.txt。

## Component compatibility sources and build helpers

Cascader, Image, ImageViewer and Anchor delegate their basic public behavior to
the installed Element Plus 2.14.7 components. ASAM supplies its styles and
documented advanced value adapters; it does not carry derived setup/render
implementations, bounded zoom, keyboard focus patches or Anchor scroll handling.

The former compatibility implementations used Element Plus gitHead
`77d5c32c4ebcfffde67e51f6325c6d350ca668a0`. Their original source identities
are retained here for historical provenance: the Cascader distribution module
SHA256 was `bac94ed4602841106d134f39056fdaca0d7fbb711fc8ff4339b7fac65391ea82`;
Anchor source `packages/components/anchor/src/anchor.vue` SHA256 was
`3a60f68d455f3e582ecffd4639c78ee24fcbf0a2bcfe0ce0cddf03583d78af2f`.
These historical identities do not imply that the derived runtime remains in
this native-delegation candidate. The original Element Plus license follows.

Build helper inputs are pinned to VueUse core 15.0.0, Element Plus Icons Vue
2.3.2 and Lodash ES 4.18.1. Other components may still use these helpers;
removing the four derived implementations does not remove their notices.
VueUse shared and metadata 15.0.0 carry the same license text as core. The
following original notices remain applicable to retained source and helper
inputs; the installed Element Plus components and Vue remain peer dependencies.

## Private declaration snapshots

The normal declaration build redistributes 590 Element Plus 2.14.7 ES declarations
and 295 Element Plus Icons Vue 2.3.2 declarations under `dist/_upstream`.
The original declaration and producer-patch hashes, module-path adaptations and
output hashes are recorded in `dist/_upstream/provenance.json` and the build input
`tools/eng-006/upstream-declarations.lock.json`. The fixed Element Plus source
identity is `77d5c32c4ebcfffde67e51f6325c6d350ca668a0`.

Eight Element Plus declarations receive the recorded strong-type corrections.
Relative declaration references use explicit NodeNext extensions. The Color
class, installation key, table placeholder key and loading directive declaration
are exact re-exports of the original peer declaration leaves, preserving private
member and unique-symbol identity. These snapshots have no runtime entry point.

The complete original MIT licenses are redistributed with each declaration
snapshot at `dist/_upstream/element-plus/LICENSE` and
`dist/_upstream/icons-vue/LICENSE`. The Element Plus and Icons Vue copyright and
license texts above also apply to these declaration derivatives. External type
providers remain normal installed dependencies; their declarations are not
copied into these snapshots.

用法与契约补充说明 ​

使用约定 ​

size 接受 large/big/default/small，省略时保留默认密度；配置变化保持响应式。子控件显式 size 优先于最近 group、Form、ConfigProvider。locale、namespace、zIndex、button、message 等配置以公开 Props 为准；它提供上下文，不直接请求业务数据。default 插槽提供真实配置上下文，无业务事件。

配置类型与本地语言包 ​

ButtonConfigContext、CardConfigContext、LinkConfigContext、TableConfigContext 分别通过 AsamConfigProvider 前缀的公开类型表示。配置表与示例直接引用这些类型。语言示例从同一个包导入 asamLocaleEn 和 asamLocaleZhCn，既可切换 locale，也可传入符合 locale 参数的其他语言对象。

更多参数与事件说明 ​

空值配置2.7.0 ​

本例第二个 AsamSelectV2 使用 value-mode="native"，保留组件覆盖全局配置后清空为 undefined 的原生值语义；第一个 AsamSelect 仍按 provider 配置清空为 null。AsamSelectV2 默认的 value 模式会将单选清空的 undefined 归一为 null，需要原生清空值时显式选择 native 模式。

import type { ComputedRef, VNode } from 'vue';

type PublicMember<T, K extends PropertyKey> = T extends unknown ? K extends keyof T ? T[K] : never : never;

// AsamConfigProviderProps
type PublicContract = {
	"button"?: AsamConfigProviderButtonConfigContext | undefined;

};
